title: Retire NERV's FPV pack views and connect NERV to FPVBuddy's MCP server
goal: After the core moves (F-101-T04), NERV's own FPV screens are gone and NERV reaches FPVBuddy's MCP server for battery data
acceptance: web/src/battery-cards.ts and the FPV pack's dashboard panels (batteries, fleet, spares, crashes) are removed with their state, helpers and tests; the FPV pack declares no dashboard panel (no dead code)
NERV is configured as an MCP client of FPVBuddy's server through the MCP guidance (docs/agents/mcp.md): the connection, its allowed read-only battery tools and the owner's data location are recorded
Misato is offered FPVBuddy's battery tools when the FPV pack is on and none when it is off; a test covers both with a fake MCP server
Chat and Telegram FPV phrases keep working (F-008, F-098); F-101-T10 moves the remaining tools

Owner decision 2026-11-25 (coordinator docs/DOMAINS.md; FPVBuddy F-008-T07, FPVBuddy#13): each project owns its screens, built with bricks; NERV keeps no copies and shows other projects' data through MCP (genUI surface cards in chat; MCP Apps pages or links for full screens).

Owner decision 2026-11-26 (chat): "accept all 17 proposals" of the cross-project audit (coordinator docs/audits/2026-11-26-cross-project.md), proposal 1: waits on fpvbuddy:F-005-T02 (met: FPVBuddy#17) instead of F-101-T04.
privacy: Owner fleet data stays local-only; the MCP connection stays on the owner's machines; tests use invented batteries and drones.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A new MCP connection or permission goes to the owner before it is enabled

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: remove battery-cards and the FPV panels with their tests, add the MCP client connection and gate its tools by the pack. Not a measurement. 2026-11-26: depends on F-101-T08 (data in FPVBuddy) instead of the cancelled F-101-T05; estimate unchanged. 2026-11-26 audit proposals: prerequisites changed, estimate unchanged.
